description: This file defines the DoctrineCacheAdapter class, which adapts the Doctrine cache to conform to AWS SDK's Cache interface and CacheInterface. It provides methods to get, set, remove, delete, check existence, and retrieve stats from a cache instance.

classes.name: DoctrineCacheAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class implementing AWS cache interfaces by wrapping Doctrine's cache implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a Doctrine Cache instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Alias for get method, fetches a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Alias for set method, saves a value with an optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Alias for remove method, deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the cache contains an entry for the given key.
